original_test_intent: Verify that the expected BMC firmware version is correct and consistent in BIOS Server Management, in-band IPMI, out-of-band IPMI, BMC WebUI and Redfish.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Read the version in BIOS, run in-band and lanplus `ipmitool mc info`, inspect BMC WebUI, and GET the Redfish Manager resource.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: All reported BMC versions are correct.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Reduced collection to one out-of-band IPMI line.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE despite BIOS/WebUI observations and a missing expected baseline.
historical_reviews.v3: Reclassified to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION and retained all five interfaces.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Engineer operates or supplies evidence from BIOS and BMC WebUI; agent may collect IPMI/Redfish and compare normalized values.
required_user_inputs: Expected BMC version and normalization rule
Verified BMC identity and protected credentials
Redfish Manager mapping and TLS policy

master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Platform version baseline, manager URI, cipher/TLS policy, credentials and UI/BIOS access method.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: IPMI or Redfish alone cannot complete a case whose intent includes BIOS and WebUI display paths.

original_method: Preserve BIOS, IPMI, BMC WebUI and Redfish checks; redact the source's embedded example credentials and never place secrets in command history or evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Discover the target under `/redfish/v1/Managers` and collect `FirmwareVersion` using an approved secret mechanism; retain BIOS and WebUI evidence because those displays are part of the test intent.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: The platform-supported Redfish schema/firmware and approved ipmitool version.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: DMTF Redfish Manager schema for FirmwareVersion; platform firmware recipe supplies the expected revision.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original: Uses resource discovery and protected authentication instead of a hard-coded manager path and URL credentials.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No functional substitution: Redfish supplements but does not replace BIOS/WebUI verification.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Redfish cannot establish the platform's private expected version and cannot prove UI rendering.

safety_boundaries: Read-only queries only; no BMC reset/update or power action.
No credential exposure and no unverified endpoint.
No unapproved reboot merely to enter BIOS.
expected_evidence: Redacted timestamped IPMI and Redfish outputs with target identity
BIOS and BMC WebUI screenshots/operator attestations
no_automatic_retry: Authentication, TLS, endpoint or version disagreement is recorded. Do not switch endpoints, ciphers or credentials and retry without approval.
engineer_owned_verdict: The agent reports each observed value and mismatch; the firmware owner decides correctness and formal PASS/FAIL.
review_improvement: V3.1 confirms V3's reclassification and explicitly separates manual UI/BIOS activity from automation capability. Missing expected version is a project input, not a permanent BLOCKED state, while required UI coverage remains intact.
